en-US.longDescription: Intel® oneAPI Toolkit is a comprehensive set of tools and libraries for building high‑performance, data‑centric applications across diverse architectures using SYCL*. It combines an industry‑leading C++ compiler, optimized domain‑specific libraries, and advanced analysis tools to build, optimize, and scale workloads ranging from traditional HPC to AI and machine learning.
